For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

We are excited to announce an opportunity to join our healthcare claims team as a Major Case Consultant Specialized Claims. This full time, exempt position offers the flexibility of working remotely while contributing to a high impact, collaborative team.

Position Overview:

The Major Case Consultant Specialized Claims role is a senior-level claims position responsible for the full lifecycle management of highly complex and high-value medical professional liability claims. This includes the investigation, evaluation, negotiation, and resolution of claims that represent the company’s largest damage exposures and often involve intricate coverage issues.

The position requires a high level of technical expertise and collaboration with professionals across various disciplines. Specialized claims handled in this role primarily focused on elder care facilities, medical negligence and additional medical malpractice.

In this role you will:

  • Independently lead investigations and manage the full lifecycle of highly complex, sensitive, and specialized claims.
  • Analyze coverage, liability, and financial exposure; develop tailored resolution strategies and negotiate high-value or contested claims.
  • Set activities, reserves, and authorize payments within high authority limits; manage litigation budgets and direct counsel payouts.
  • Coordinate with internal and external experts (e.g., forensic analysts, underwriters, legal counsel, contractors) to ensure thorough evaluations and resolution.
  • Identify and pursue risk transfer opportunities; manage suspicious claims and refer to Special Investigation Unit as needed.
  • Ensure compliance across jurisdictions including licensing, forms, deadlines, and accounting; maintain accurate and complete claim records.
  • Protect personally identifiable information (PII) and promote best practices across the team.
  • Represent the company in litigation, mediations, settlement conferences, and arbitrations; provide large loss and reinsurance reporting to underwriting.
  • Lead cross-functional meetings and collaborate with underwriting, agents, vendors, and legal teams to drive consensus and resolve claims.
  • Identify coverage gaps and partner with product management to enhance offerings.
  • Lead quality initiatives to streamline workflows; use data tools to analyze trends and correct inconsistencies.
  • Maintain strong time and desk management skills; prepare reports and contribute to special projects.
  • Attend industry events and continuing education seminars to stay current on best practices.
  • Tailor communication strategies for specialized claims and maintain regular updates with leadership.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and stakeholders.

What you need to apply:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience accepted, with 8+ years of relevant work experience required. JD preferred or equivalent legal/claims experience. Industry designations (e.g., CPCU, AIC) strongly preferred.
  • Extensive experience handling highly complex, high-value claims with significant legal, financial, and reputational exposure.
  • Recognized authority in negotiation and resolution of complex claims; able to shape best practices and influence outcomes.
  • Demonstrated expertise in analyzing policy coverage, legal liability, and regulatory frameworks across jurisdictions.
  • Proven ability to manage litigation strategy, direct counsel, and represent the company in trials, mediations, and arbitrations.
  • Experience mentoring others and contributing to the development of investigative techniques, compliance protocols, and claims handling standards.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to simplify complex information and handle sensitive issues with professionalism.
  • Skilled in selecting appropriate communication channels and demonstrating empathy across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Ability to draft clear, factual, and objective work product without opinion.
  • Highly organized with proven ability to manage complex workflows, projects, and competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated time management and organizational skills; able to coach others in these areas.
  • Deep understanding of insurance principles, coverage interpretation, and jurisdictional requirements.
  • Strategic thinker with sound judgment; able to make informed decisions independently and assess financial implications.
  • Expert in identifying and mitigating legal, regulatory, and reputational risks.
  • Recognized for developing empathetic customer service strategies and delivering exceptional service.

Core Capabilities:

  • Analytical Reasoning: The ability to identify problems, understand your impact, gather input and data, and develop an effective solution.
  • Customer Centricity: Makes customers/clients and their needs a primary focus of one’s actions; shows interest in and understanding of the needs and expectations of internal and external customers; gains customer trust and respect; meets or exceeds customer expectations.
  • Digital Fluency: Effectively uses digital tools and technology appropriately to find, evaluate, create, and communicate information understands how to navigate digital platforms, use software applications, and leverage technology for productivity and communication purposes.
  • Persuasion and Influence: Uses appropriate interpersonal skills and techniques to gain acceptance for ideas or solutions; uses influencing strategies to gain genuine agreements; seeks to persuade rather than force solutions or impose decisions or regulations.
  • Professional Insurance Acumen: Demonstrates a deepening understanding of the insurance industry and the ability to apply specialized technical skills to address complex challenges, adapt to industry trends, and drive value for the organization.
  • Planning and Execution: Plans, prioritizes and manages resources and time effectively to achieve specific goals or deadlines.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

  • Ability to use a personal computer and other standard office equipment.
  • Ability to sit and/or stand for extended periods.
  • Required to work on-site as needed.
  • Ability to travel as necessary.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced, changing or stressful environment.
  • Ability to perform work in a noisy/loud work environment.
  • May be required to have and maintain sufficient home internet.

CAREER DEVELOPMENT:

It’s not just a job, it’s a career, and we are here to support you every step of the way. We want you to be successful and fulfilled. Through on-the-job experiences, personalized coaching and our robust learning and development programs, we encourage you – at every level – to grow and develop.

BENEFITS:

We offer comprehensive benefits to help you be healthy, build financial security, and balance work and home life. At The Hanover, you’ll enjoy what you do and have the support you need to succeed.

Benefits include:

At Montage International, we are doing something different, something exciting and it takes passionate people to bring our vision to life. Please Click Hereto apply internally.

At Montage & Pendry, It’s All Because of YOU!

Imagine turning your passion and talent into a fulfilling career. Imagine a beautiful workplace where you can learn, grow, and have fun. At Montage & Pendry, we know our success is all because of you. Here, you’re not just an associate but a passionate creator of authentic, personalized experiences. You’ll feel empowered to think creatively, discover career growth opportunities, and have fun while crafting lasting, cherished moments for our guests. Working at Montage & Pendry is more than a job; it’s a way of life. Don’t just imagine the possibility — join us.

Montage International (MI) seeks to collaborate with our owner, investor, and design partners to deliver exceptional properties that continue to build on our artistic collection of distinctive luxury hotels, resorts, and residences. The Design and Development Services (DDS) team guides the creation and thoughtful positioning of memorable and unique design solutions that reflect the Montage and Pendry brand philosophies and exceed our guests’ and residents’ expectations. The DDS team provides the knowledge and resources to ensure the unique requirements and operational relationships in front-of-house and back-of-house areas of each property are optimized, and all our hotel, resort, and residential properties conform to MI’s uniformly high standards.

The Vice President, Development Services, Capex and Design Execution (VP, DS) leads capital planning, FF&E strategy, and hotel opening support across Montage International’s portfolio, partnering with property leadership and Ownership and Corporate Operations on asset investment. The VP, DS also serves as the Company’s FF&E subject matter expert and provides hands-on field design leadership during new hotel openings. As a senior member of the Design and Development Services team, the VP, DS brings strong communication, sound judgment, and disciplined process to each project, working closely with Development leadership and the MI Operations team.

Your Leadership

Job duties include and are not limited to:

  • Direct the DDS Capex resources guiding capital improvement and renovation planning throughout each property’s lifecycle, supporting Owners, operating hotels, and residential properties in identifying areas of opportunity for renovation and investment. This successfully maintains the positioning of each asset, and adherence to brand guidelines.
    • Engage directly with MI Corporate Operations, Property Leadership Teams and Ownership to build a proactive, asset protection focused capital planning process.
    • Provide executive oversight of the annual capital budget process and long-term portfolio capital planning, reviewing scopes, budgets, and schedules developed by the Senior Director, and stepping in on strategic decisions, escalations, and complex owner relationships as needed.
    • Collaborate with MI Corporate Design to ensure projects transition successfully through the design process.
    • Build partnerships with Ownership and property teams through transparent communication and strategic guidance on capital investments, navigating operational and financial priorities to protect the long-term quality of each asset.
  • Serve as Montage International’s subject matter expert for Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E) throughout development, hotel opening, and lifecycle asset management.
    • Direct the development of FF&E Standards and oversee their implementation across the pipeline and portfolio, including review of design documentation, specifications, material selections, shop drawings, and product substitutions to ensure consistency with approved design intent.
    • Review, validate, and monitor FF&E/OS&E budgets through all stages of design, providing initial cost estimates as needed, tracking budgets against actuals, and guiding value engineering decisions in collaboration with owners, consultants, and project managers.
    • Evaluate and guide procurement strategy in collaboration with our partners, including owner-appointed procurement agents and third-party or in-house procurement services, and vendor pricing negotiations, to ensure the best value, quality, schedule, and logistics without compromising design intent.
    • Conduct factory visits, prototype reviews, and quality inspections for custom furnishings as needed. Partner with interior design teams and procurement consultants to resolve fabrication, installation, and quality issues, and providing executive recommendations on FF&E acceptance and corrective action.
  • Support field execution of design from DD/construction documentation completion through hotel opening, partnering with the assigned DDS Director and Development design leadership.
    • Serve as a key on-site member of the DDS team during hotel openings, coordinating with colleagues responsible for commissioning, punch list completion, FF&E installation, and systems testing. raw.title: Senior Manager, Product Marketing
raw.excerpt: The AutoVitals suite of SaaS products is designed to solve many of the current hurdles faced by auto repair shops.
raw.description:
The AutoVitals suite of SaaS products is designed to solve many of the current hurdles faced by auto repair shops. Our mission is to help auto repair shops drive profitable growth by attracting new customers, delivering superior communication and customer service, increasing shop efficiency, and raising average repair orders.

We are building product marketing as a dedicated function for the first time and looking for someone to own it and build it. This role takes our products to market: positioning and messaging across the suite, who each product is for by shop size and by role, the launch plans that turn a release into revenue, and our competitive picture. This is a hands-on role. You will write the messaging, build the plan, and sit with sales to make sure it lands. Over time you will build the function, hire and develop product marketers, and put in place the standards and playbooks it runs on. The scope of this role grows with the function you build.

Product marketing works across product, sales, and marketing. You take what is coming from Product and turn it into something Sales can sell. Before a campaign goes out, this role provides the air cover: segmented messaging and content that warms up a market so a prospect is already primed when sales makes contact. You will coordinate with demand generation and content so one message reaches each segment through one plan, not several.

Responsibilities

  • Own positioning, messaging, and value proposition for every product in the AutoVitals suite, grounded in buyer needs and differentiated by shop size and by buyer role
  • Define who we sell to by revenue band, location count, and role, and keep that segmentation and their pain points current as the product catalog and market evolve
  • Partner with Product on what is coming and translate the roadmap into market-facing language before it ships
  • Partner with Brand on product naming and identity so the product story and the company story line up
  • Own the go-to-market plan for every launch on the product roadmap, including audience, message, sequence, channels, internal readiness across sales, support, training, and shop success, and the measures of whether it worked
  • Own the launch communication plan across clients, prospects, and internal teams, including FAQs so everyone answers questions the same way
  • Own adoption of features already in market, not just what is new, so existing shops know what they have and use it
  • Own the competitive picture end to end, including who we win against, who we lose to, and why, with battlecards, win and loss themes, and positioning against the platforms shops evaluate alongside us
  • Bring the competitive read into pricing, packaging, and roadmap conversations, and keep leadership current on what is changing in the market
  • Build the material sales actually uses: decks, one-pagers, talk tracks, objection handling, and FAQs tied to the problems shops are trying to solve
  • Own the customer proof points and reference stories sales relies on, and work with content to get them produced
  • Give campaigns air cover with segmented messaging and content that runs ahead of outreach, coordinating with demand generation and content so one consistent message reaches each segment
  • Measure what you build against sales adoption and pipeline, and improve it based on what closes
  • Build product marketing into a function with defined standards, process, and an operating cadence with product, sales, and the rest of marketing so launches are planned, not reactive
  • Hire, onboard, and develop product marketers as the team grows, and define how they align to areas of the product and their product management counterparts

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product marketing at a B2B SaaS or technology company
  • Experience conducting market discovery through customer, prospect, and win and loss interviews, then translating those insights into validated market problems, buyer personas, positioning, and go-to-market decisions
  • Experience managing or developing product marketers and building the process, standards, and playbooks a function runs on, not only doing the work yourself
  • Track record owning product launches end to end, from positioning through sales readiness and results
  • Strong writer and clear communicator who can take a technical product and say plainly what it does and who it is for, across all levels of an organization
  • Experience building competitive intelligence from scratch, including research, battlecards, and win and loss analysis
  • Experience segmenting a market and building differentiated messaging by segment and by buyer role
  • Comfortable working directly with sales reps, sitting in on calls, and building what they will actually use
  • Data-literate, able to connect messaging and launch work to pipeline and bookings
  • Comfortable building from scratch in a fast-moving environment where not everything is defined yet
  • Bonus
    • Pragmatic Marketing or Product Marketing Alliance certification
    • Experience taking a multi-product platform to market
    • Experience marketing to small and medium-sized businesses, particularly in automotive, home services, or a similar vertical
    • Familiarity with Salesforce and HubSpot
    • Background or knowledge of the automotive repair industry

Salary Range Transparency

Annual Total Compensation Range: $135,000 – $155,000 OTE (includes base salary up to $140,909 + 10% target bonus).

Individual compensation offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, applicable skills, educational background, relevant experience

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • 401K Match
  • Flexible PTO

raw.excerpt: Vous joindre à AbbVie signifie que vous ferez partie d’une équipe de professionnels exceptionnels qui se sont engagés à avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des patients.
raw.description:
Vous joindre à AbbVie signifie que vous ferez partie d’une équipe de professionnels exceptionnels qui se sont engagés à avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des patients. À AbbVie, nous effectuons des recherches scientifiques révolutionnaires à l’échelle mondiale au quotidien. AbbVie Canada est l’un des meilleurs lieux de travail au Canada.

En choisissant votre cheminement de carrière, choisissez d’être remarquable.

AbbVie a pour mission de découvrir et d’offrir des médicaments novateurs pour répondre à des besoins importants en matière de santé aujourd’hui et relever les défis médicaux de demain. AbbVie met tout en œuvre afin d’avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des gens dans divers secteurs thérapeutiques clés, dont l’immunologie, l’oncologie, les neurosciences, les soins de la vue, la virologie, la santé des femmes et la gastroentérologie, de même que dans le domaine de l’esthétique par le truchement des produits et services d’Allergan Aesthetics.

We have an opportunity for Senior Manager, Market Access & Government Affairs to join our Market Access and Government Affairs (MA & GA) team. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing public payer reimbursement of AbbVie products in Oncology as well as supporting the government affairs / regional policy initiatives for Quebec and all the provinces in Atlantic Canada. The incumbent will report to the Lead, Market Access and Government Affairs- Oncology.

Position Summary

Lead AbbVie’s government affairs and market access strategy for Oncology products across Quebec and Atlantic Canada. This role will build trusted relationships with government decision-makers, public and private payers, and key healthcare stakeholders to advance policy, strengthen market access, and support optimal reimbursement conditions.

The ideal candidate will bring 10+ years of experience in government affairs, market access, health policy, or a related field. Pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical experience and candidates with strong policy expertise from other sectors. Exceptional government affairs, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills are essential. Ideal candidate will be located in Quebec, we may consider Atlantic based candidates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute regional government affairs, health policy, and market access strategies for Quebec and Atlantic Canada.
  • Secure and maintain market access and optimal reimbursement for oncology products with provincial payers and cancer agencies.
  • Build and manage productive relationships with the offices of ministers and premiers, deputy ministers, senior civil servants, other policy makers public and private payers, drug plan managers, and other health policy influencers.
  • Monitor legislation, regulations, and policy developments; identify barriers and opportunities; and develop timely responses, and policy recommendations.
  • Influence provincial legislation, regulation and policy by translating AbbVie’s clinical, policy positions and economic, and patient value propositions into compelling stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Develop annual regional customer plans, track execution and impact, and ensure alignment with national market access and government affairs priorities.
  • Collaborate with Market Access, HEOR, Medical, patient engagement, communications, Commercial, and cross-functional brand teams to deliver integrated engagement plans.
  • Support provincial patient evidence submissions and advocacy initiatives in partnership with the cross functional team
  • Lead multi-stakeholder projects that address policymaker and public payer priorities and position AbbVie as a trusted, expert partner.
  • In collaboration with cross-functional colleagues, Provide policymakers and drug plan managers with relevant clinical, health economic, outcomes research, and real-world evidence.
  • Represent AbbVie on relevant provincial and regional biopharmaceutical industry committees, including Innovative Medicines Canada, and provincial life sciences organizations.
  • Manage regional brand and corporate budgets and support financial planning cycles.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, science, public policy, health administration, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in government affairs, market access, public or health policy, consulting or working within the public sector or government. Those with experience in Pharmaceutical and other regulated industries are encouraged to apply.
  • Demonstrated track record of success influencing legislation, regulation, health policy, or public reimbursement decisions.
  • Strong policy analysis skills, including the ability to assess proposed legislation and health policies and respond quickly and effectively in writing.
  • Deep understanding of the Canadian healthcare and reimbursement landscape, including provincial governments, public drug plans, private payers, Canada’s Drug Agency, INESSS, and related drug approval and funding processes.
  • Experience engaging senior stakeholders and payers in Quebec and Atlantic Canada.
  • Understanding of health economics, pharmacoeconomics, outcomes research, and real-world evidence principles.
  • Ability to foster strategic partnerships with external stakeholders

Essential Skills and Capabilities

  • Exceptional government and stakeholder relationship management skills.
  • Strong policy judgment and the ability to anticipate and shape the external environment.
  • Ability to convert business and brand priorities into practical, strategic government affairs and market access plans.
  • Ability to develop compelling value propositions tailored to policymakers, payers, and public healthcare stakeholders.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and strategic planning skills.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing capabilities.
  • Strong story telling and communication skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-paced, and highly regulated environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfortable using AI tools
  • Valid driver’s license and passport required.
  • AbbVie aims to offer a French-speaking workplace in Quebec and has made efforts to limit English requirements. However, advanced English skills are essential for this role because the position involves working with English-speaking employees, clients, and regions outside Quebec. French is also required as the role will communicate with French speaking stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to work within a matrix environment with strong collaboration skills.

Travel approximately 25% within Canada and 5% internationally.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and encourages women, Aboriginal peoples, persons with disabilities, and members of visible minorities to apply.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community.  Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

US & Puerto Rico only - to learn more, visit

US & Puerto Rico applicants seeking a reasonable accommodation, click here to learn more:

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at . Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn,Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

raw.description:
ProcessUnity is the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) company. Our software platforms and data services protect customers from cybersecurity threats, breaches, and outages that originate from their ever-growing ecosystem of business partners. By combining the world’s largest third-party risk data exchange, the leading TPRM workflow platform, and powerful artificial intelligence, ProcessUnity extends third-party risk, procurement, and cybersecurity teams so they can cover their entire vendor portfolio. With ProcessUnity, organizations of all sizes reduce assessment work while improving quality, securing intellectual property and customer data so business operations continue to operate uninterrupted.

ProcessUnity leads the third-party risk management market at a moment when vendor portfolios are growing larger and more complex, and data-driven decision-making has become central to how our customers run their risk programs. Our Exchange platform is the engine behind that shift: it turns raw risk data into consumable, actionable risk profiles that customers can put to work immediately.

The Senior Product Owner joins the Exchange product team to help expand the risk data available on the platform, making it easier for customers to consume, and ensuring it's accessible through AI so customers can act on it faster and with more confidence. This is an execution-focused role at the center of turning strategy into delivered product.

The ideal candidate is energized by complex challenges and emerging technology, and ready to channel that energy into real results. You'll partner closely with product managers and engineering to take on high-impact problems and drive them to working solutions — owning the backlog, translating business requirements into executable stories, and using data and AI to keep delivery moving.

What You'll Do:

  • Partner directly with product managers to understand product vision, identify business challenges, and participate in discovery
  • Drive execution of the product roadmap, translating customer needs, market direction, and business goals into delivered work
  • Translate business requirements into user stories with clear acceptance criteria; drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives
  • Collaborate with engineering, design, data science, and QA to bring products to market
  • Produce documentation for feature releases, such as release notes, knowledge base articles, and internal enablement materials
  • Align with product managers on success metrics, track usage, and use data to drive continuous improvement
  • Triage bugs and drive prioritization, resolution, and status communication back to the business
  • Use AI throughout the product lifecycle - research, story writing, prioritization, design, and delivery

Desired Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of product experience, including product owner, business analyst, and/or execution-focused product responsibilities
  • Technical acumen with APIs and integrations
  • Proven experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Strong understanding of user experience (UX) principles
  • Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in third-party risk management or rating/scoring platforms preferred

Compensation Range: $105,000 - $135,000 depending on experience

As a National Accounts Manager (NAM), you’ll get to retain existing customers and grow new business by developing and cultivating strong customer relationships with our Key Account Customers. The NAM will continuously seek to understand the customer needs through constant contact, consultation, and by ensuring cross functionality within the organization. The successful candidate will be knowledgeable on the entire organization’s suite of offerings and sell appropriately to each respective customer. This role is vital to our success and growth as an organization!

Here's a look at some of the services you'll sell!

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for customer facing relationships at all levels of our national accounts, including:
    • Building and maintaining a mindset of becoming a trusted advisor
    • Seeking deeper understanding of customers’ business needs and strategic initiatives to bring solutions forward and uncover new service offerings and revenue streams
    • Meeting or exceeding retention, growth, and profitability targets for assigned customer, including managing an active pipeline of opportunities to grow profitable share
    • Developing and executing business plans for assigned customers with annual, quarterly, and monthly objectives
    • Ensure customer satisfaction and retention by effectively managing service and material quality while meeting customer contract terms and SLAs
    • Understand customers’ total program, identify value add opportunities and manage projects to capture those throughout the contract
    • Identifying and quantifying new opportunities within the account
  • Work closely with onboarding new accounts (or new sites) utilizing resources within functional partners, including Sales, Brokerage and Customer Service teams
  • Develop and implement account plans that document specific sales strategies and tactics
  • Facilitate and execute planned renewal sales activities on a target list of existing customers with favorable language per company guidelines
  • Develop presentations for account specific communication plans and business reviews that effectively and powerfully communicate the company’s value proposition
  • Regularly analyze the customer book to identify customer trends and account profitability and opportunities to add greater value for the customer
  • Forecast and track sales revenues and activities in a timely manner using the customer relationship management (CRM) system and other tools
  • Maintain accurate records of sales activity, contacts, opportunities, account information and pipeline activity
  • Coordinate quarterly business reviews to communicate performance, reinforce value and additional value-added propositions
  • Maintain awareness of industry trends, market conditions and competitive environment to proactively communicate opportunities with customers

Title: Bilingual Talent Acquisition Specialist (Eng/French) - 12 Month Maternity Leave Contract
Desired Location: All Canada Remote - Must be bilingual

The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei, Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Desired Location

Your Misson:

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist you’ll be part of the engine behind Nuvei’s growth - bringing in the talent that drives our global success.

You’ll own the full recruitment lifecycle across a variety of roles across different locations, from sourcing and screening to stakeholder partnership and offer negotiation. You’ll collaborate with hiring managers, build trusted relationships, and deliver an exceptional candidate experience every time.

We’re open to upskilling across 360 recruitment, but you’ll already bring solid stakeholder management and sourcing expertise - and if you’ve worked in payments, fintech, or high-volume hiring, that’s even better.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for assigned roles across roles globally, with a focus on North America and Latin America, ensuring a positive and exceptional experience for both candidates and hiring managers.
  • Source, attract, and engage top talent through various platforms, networks, and creative outreach methods
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical or recurring positions
  • Conduct screenings and interviews, ensuring high-quality candidate evaluation and alignment with company culture
  • Maintain accurate records and data in Workable (ATS) and other tracking tools.
  • Collaborate with global TA colleagues to share best practices and ensure process consistency

Requirements

  • 1-2+ years of recruitment experience, ideally in-house or within an agency setting.
  • Proven stakeholder management experience - comfortable influencing and partnering with hiring managers.
  • Strong sourcing skills, using tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other creative methods.
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments; payments, fintech, or high-volume hiring experience a strong plus.
  • Experience recruiting across different locations in North America and LATAM regions is a strong plus.
  • Fluency in English and French is mandatory

Benefits

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can’t wait to meet you.

  • Competitive holiday allowance
  • Group Insurance Benefits
  • Flexible working model
  • Employee Assistance Program

Our recruitment process may use automated tools, including AI, to support application management and candidate shortlisting.

Working Language
English (written and spoken) is the language used most of the time, as work colleagues, clients, and strategic suppliers are geographically dispersed.

Se você tem facilidade na comunicação, visão estratégica, atitude hands-on e quer ser protagonista de sua carreira, gostaríamos muito de conhecer você!

  • Liderar frentes de trabalho de ponta a ponta, garantindo qualidade, prazo e impacto das entregas;
  • Estruturar problemas complexos, formular hipóteses e definir as análises necessárias para orientar a tomada de decisão;
  • Conduzir diagnósticos de negócio a partir de dados, KPIs, entrevistas, benchmarks e outras fontes de informação;

  • Coordenar consultores e analistas, direcionando atividades, revisando entregáveis e apoiando o desenvolvimento do time;
  • Coordenar a execução da frente, antecipando riscos, dependências e desvios de escopo ou cronograma e atuando para destravar temas críticos;
  • Apoiar a implementação das recomendações e o acompanhamento dos resultados e valor capturado;
  • Atuar como referência para o cliente e para o time nos temas sob sua responsabilidade, propondo soluções e atuando de forma proativa;

Formação:

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas;

Competências e conhecimentos necessários:

  • Experiência em consultoria de gestão, estratégia, transformação ou projetos de alta complexidade;
  • Experiência liderando frentes de trabalho e profissionais mais juniores;
  • Forte capacidade de resolução estruturada de problemas e raciocínio analítico;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com dados e transformar análises em conclusões e recomendações;
  • Excelente capacidade de síntese e comunicação executiva, oral e escrita;
  • Experiência na construção de apresentações e materiais para tomada de decisão;

  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes de alta complexidade e ambiguidade;
  • Inglês avançado para atuação em ambiente profissional

Conhecimentos desejáveis:

  • Experiência prévia em consultorias de estratégia, gestão ou transformação;
  • Experiência em projetos com exposição direta à alta liderança;
  • Vivência em projetos de transformação com impacto mensurável em receita, custos, experiência do cliente ou eficiência operacional;
  • Experiência na construção de business cases, benchmarks, modelos analíticos e recomendações estratégicas;

HERE TO DARE

raw.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Revenue Accounting depends on trusted data, scalable systems, and efficient processes to support accurate reporting and informed decision-making. As a Senior Revenue Accounting Systems & Automation Analyst at Genesys, you will shape how the organization uses systems, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies to improve reporting quality, strengthen controls, and reduce manual effort.


This senior individual contributor role sits at the intersection of revenue accounting, finance systems, data, and technology. You will own complex improvement initiatives from problem identification through implementation, translating accounting and business requirements into practical solutions across Salesforce, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, Snowflake, Tableau Cloud, Tableau Prep, Microsoft Excel, and related data flows.


You will partner with Revenue Accounting, Finance Systems, IT, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, and other Finance teams to improve data accessibility, simplify processes, resolve systemic issues, and build scalable reporting and monitoring capabilities. Your work will help Revenue Accounting identify issues earlier, make better-informed decisions, and operate effectively as transaction volumes, data complexity, and business needs evolve.


This role also offers direct exposure to enterprise finance and technology initiatives, including opportunities to expand expertise in AI-enabled accounting, automation, data architecture, and platform optimization. At Genesys, collaboration, empathy for customers and colleagues, and ambitious thinking guide how teams solve complex problems and create better experiences.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end development and enhancement of revenue accounting reports, dashboards, analytics, and data models that improve recurring reporting, ad hoc analysis, and decision-making
  • Drive automation and process simplification initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve scalability, strengthen controls, and increase operational efficiency across Revenue Accounting
  • Partner with Revenue Accounting stakeholders to translate complex accounting and business requirements into scalable system, reporting, data, and automation solutions
  • Lead the design and implementation of practical AI-enabled solutions for reporting, analysis, documentation, reconciliations, and process support, incorporating appropriate governance and human oversight
  • Design and optimize Tableau Cloud dashboards and Tableau Prep workflows that improve reporting consistency, transparency, usability, and access to revenue data
  • Analyze revenue-related data across Snowflake and other sources to reconcile information between systems, identify anomalies and root causes, and improve data quality and decision support
  • Develop advanced Excel models and analytical tools where they provide business value while reducing unnecessary reliance on manually maintained spreadsheets
  • Drive enhancements across Salesforce, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, and related revenue data flows to improve system performance, data integrity, and end-to-end accounting processes
  • Influence strategy and execution across Revenue Accounting, Finance Systems, IT, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, and Finance by aligning stakeholders on sustainable solutions to complex data and process challenges
  • Develop repeatable exception reporting and monitoring capabilities that enable earlier issue detection, proactive investigation, and more reliable revenue accounting processes
  • Evaluate and implement appropriate generative AI, automation, and emerging technology use cases that expand the analytical and operational capabilities of Revenue Accounting
  • Document processes, data flows, business requirements, system logic, controls, and automated workflows to support operational continuity, governance, and audit readiness

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting processes, and revenue-related business processes
  • Demonstrated experience working with complex financial and operational data across multiple enterprise systems
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel expertise, including complex formulas, pivot tables, large dataset analysis, financial modeling, and efficient spreadsheet design
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, including experience investigating complex issues, identifying root causes, and developing practical solutions
  • Demonstrated experience with financial reporting, analytics, automation, finance systems, or process improvement initiatives
  • Proven ability to translate accounting and business requirements into scalable reporting, data, automation, or system solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex initiatives from problem identification and requirements definition through implementation and adoption
  • Strong background in data integrity, financial controls, process documentation, governance, and auditability
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate across Accounting, Finance, Systems, Data, and technical teams

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Salesforce, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, or comparable enterprise billing and revenue platforms
  • Experience using Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms to analyze, reconcile, and investigate complex financial datasets
  • Experience developing Tableau Cloud dashboards and Tableau Prep workflows or using comparable business intelligence and data preparation tools
  • Experience applying automation, generative AI, or other emerging technologies to finance, accounting, reporting, or analytical workflows
  • Experience designing exception reporting, monitoring, or control frameworks that support proactive identification of data and process issues
  • Demonstrated success influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving systems or process improvements without direct authority

Compensation:

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.

$103,400.00 - $181,800.00

  • Telehealth coverage

  • Flexible work schedules and work from home opportunities

  • Development and career growth opportunities

  • Open Time Off in addition to 10 paid holidays

  • 401(k) matching program

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Fertility treatments

Click here to view a summary overview of our Benefits.


Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.

What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:

raw.description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

About the Role

This position supports the Clinical Operations functions and acts as a liaison between Members, Physicians, Delegates, Operational Business members and Member Service Coordinators

What You'll Do

  • Performs review of service requests for completeness of information, collection and transfer of non-clinical data, and acquisition of structured clinical data from physicians/patients.
  • Prepare, document and route cases in appropriate system for clinical review. Initiates call backs and correspondence to members and providers to coordinate and clarify benefits.
  • Upon completion of inquiries initiate call back or correspondence to Physicians/Members to coordinate/clarify case completion.
  • Reviewing professional medical/claim policy related issues or claims in pending status.
  • Acts as liaison with providers, members and Care Managers.
  • Perform other relevant tasks as assigned by Management.

Utilization Management:

  • Upon collection of clinical and non-clinical information MCC can authorize services based upon scripts or algorithms used for pre-review screening.
  • Non Clinical staff members are not responsible for conducting any UM review activities that require interpretation of clinical information.
  • Handles initial screening for pre-certification requests from physicians/members via incoming calls or correspondence based on scripts and workflows, and under the oversight of clinical staff.

Case Management:

  • Assists members with finding providers, resolving problems and answering questions regarding anything from how to obtain services to how to file an appeal.
  • Makes outbound calls to in order to engage members in Case Management and to complete the necessary health assessment(s) (IHS/HRA, CNA/CMNA, MLTSS Elig Survey*.)
  • Educates members regarding preventive health activities and services.
  • Assists member to make appointments with their PCP, specialists, and/or transportation, etc. Handle PCP, demographic changes and/or new ID cards as requested by members.
  • Triage and distribute referrals from Member Services and incoming faxes from providers.
  • Reviews medical, dental and vision claims and address gaps in member's preventative care.

Letters Team:

  • Review medical and administrative documentation for accuracy, grammar, and compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Perform initial screening of determination letters, ensuring clarity and compliance before distribution.
  • Make sound, timely decisions under the direction and supervision of a designated Supervisor.

What You Bring

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.
  • Prefer 1-2 years customer service or medical support related position.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Requires knowledge of medical terminology, Preferred – Medicaid CM.
  • Requires Good Oral and Written Communication skills.
  • Requires ability to make sound decisions under the direction of Supervisor.
  • Prefer knowledge of contracts, enrollment, billing & claims coding/processing.
  • Prefer knowledge Managed Care principles.
  • Prefer the ability to analyze and resolve problems with minimal supervision.
  • Prefer the ability to use a personal computer and applicable software and systems.
  • Team Player, Strong Analytical, Interpersonal Skills.

Why Horizon?

At Horizon, you’ll do meaningful work that directly improves lives—while being supported by a mission‑driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and growth. We believe that when our people thrive, our communities do too. If you are passionate about making an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

raw.description:
The Team

The Technical Solutions Go-to-Market team reimagines and accelerates AI-native innovation through a human-centered design and data-driven strategy. We are a specialized pre-sales team of Service Design Strategists, Solution Architects, AI Architects, and Data Architects who partner with Marquee and strategic customers during pre-sales motion to co-create solutions to their most pressing business challenges, and to drive AI NNACV for ServiceNow. Through our rapid, lean process, we integrate deep customer empathy, with technical possibility, with business outcomes—delivering production adjacent solutions and progressing ServiceNow AI product adoption.

Design Strategist

The strategist combines product knowledge with deep customer understanding and design thinking to translate fragmented business challenges into cohesive AI-native solutions. Through human and data discovery, they uncover real opportunities and define in close collaboration with the AI and Solution Architects how the platform solves them in the customer's own language. They orchestrate stakeholder alignment around a shared vision grounded in customer insights, building trust and clarity at every level. This role has natural synergies with teams outside their own, eg. Inspire Value (business value team), Marquee (top accounts), Account Execs, and Product Design.

The Role
You thrive at the intersection of human needs and AI-driven business impact. You're a self-motivated leader and hands-on maker who excels in ambiguous, highly collaborative environments - synthesizing diverse perspectives across client, sales, and product to drive clarity and alignment.

What You'll Do:

  • Align engagement to impact: Partner with Leadership, Value team, Account and AI, Data and Solution Architects to connect customer engagements directly to business objectives and revenue opportunities
  • Facilitate discovery & design: Plan and co-deliver design thinking workshops with customers (end-users through C-suite) and account teams, uncovering current-state realities
  • Synthesize and co-create: Lead research activities with the team, then translate insights into collaborative future-state solutions with customers and internal stakeholders
  • Translate to experience: Transform co-created narratives into tangible experiences that can be sold and implemented driving accelerated time to value for the customer
  • Communicate across audiences: Articulate concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with skill in translating complex ideas for executive visibility
  • Build the narrative: Create and publish engagement stories and artifacts that amplify customer wins and inform product strategy

To be successful in this role, we need someone who has:

  • 8+ years of Service Design experience with the ability to envision and inspire holistic customer-centric solutions
  • 5+ years of ServiceNow platform experience
  • Experience in Solution Sales
  • Comfort and ease in customer-facing meetings (pitching and planning sessions) and workshops (facilitating)
  • Experience in conceptualization, design strategy, UX, and art direction of prototypes
  • Understanding native mobile, web application, and responsive web design experience
  • Command of design basics: readability, iconography, color, and spatial relationships
  • Familiarity with collaboration, design and prototyping tools such as Zoom whiteboard, Figma and Claude
  • Strong storytelling and communication design skills

Key attributes:

  • Highly collaborative, team player
  • Comfortable in ambiguity
  • Experience working with enterprise customers
  • Experience working with ServiceNow
  • Product, sales, business strategy

Relevant Mindset

  • Confident, collaborative, and flexible as a member and discipline leader in an interdisciplinary team where teamwork is imperative to drive better customer outcomes.
  • An endless supply of passion and curiosity
  • Expected Travel: 15-20%

What we will need to see before or during your interview:

  • An inspiring portfolio of insightful experiences
  • Any publicly available projects

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. About NetDocuments

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

  • Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies
  • Five-time Top Workplace USA winner
  • Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace
  • Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

NetDocuments is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to help shape the next generation of our document management platform. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who brings deep expertise building production-grade full stack applications and a strong track record of leading technical direction within their team.

You’ll operate as a hands-on technical leader, helping drive the architecture and delivery of scalable, event-driven systems across React, TypeScript, Node.js, C#/.NET, and AWS. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Platform Services, and engineering leadership to solve complex technical challenges, integrate emerging technologies including AI-powered services, and ensure our platform continues to scale with the performance, reliability, and security our customers expect.

You will:

Technical Leadership & Team Impact

  • Serve as a hands-on technical leader, helping define technical direction and engineering standards across the team.

  • Lead architectural discussions and make technical decisions across frontend, backend, and distributed systems.

  • Establish patterns for building scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable applications.

  • Guide the evolution of the technology stack as the platform matures and scales.

  • Drive technical initiatives that improve system performance, reliability, developer experience, and engineering quality.

Design & Build

  • Architect and build production-grade full stack applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, C#/.NET, and AWS.

  • Design and implement event-driven architectures using AWS services, Kafka, and modern data pipelines.

  • Build responsive frontend experiences that make complex document management workflows intuitive and efficient.

  • Design scalable REST and GraphQL APIs that power product experiences and third-party integrations.

  • Build content enrichment and search capabilities that surface insights across large volumes of documents.

  • Integrate AI-powered services and emerging technologies that enhance document intelligence and user productivity.

System Performance & Operational Excellence

  • Design resilient systems that maintain reliability and performance as the platform scales globally.

  • Instrument applications with logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and telemetry to proactively identify and diagnose issues.

  • Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement improvements to scalability and reliability.

  • Ensure security, performance, and compliance requirements are incorporated throughout system design and implementation.

  • Proactively identify and address technical debt across the platform.

Problem Solving & Ownership

  • Own complex technical initiatives from initial design through production deployment and ongoing evolution.

  • Solve challenges across areas such as real-time search, event-driven document processing, frontend performance, and distributed systems.

  • Evaluate architectural trade-offs across performance, usability, security, scalability, and maintainability.

  • Create clear technical documentation, including architectural diagrams, system designs, and key technical decisions.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Partner closely with Product and Design to translate customer and business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  • Mentor engineers across experience levels and help elevate technical capabilities and engineering practices across the team.

  • Collaborate with Platform Services and other engineering teams on shared infrastructure and integration points.

  • Build alignment around technical approaches and provide clear direction when decisions need to be made.

  • Lead knowledge sharing through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, and hands-on technical guidance.

Continuous Learning & Innovation

  • Stay current with modern full stack development, cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and AI-powered technologies.

  • Research and validate emerging technologies through proof-of-concepts aligned with product and engineering strategy.

  • Identify opportunities to improve both customer experience and engineering velocity.

  • Leverage modern development and AI tooling to increase engineering effectiveness and impact.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production-grade applications at scale.

  • 3+ years of experience providing technical leadership and influencing engineering direction and practices.

  • Deep experience with React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript.

  • Strong backend development experience with C#/.NET or Java and TypeScript/Node.js.

  • Experience designing and operating event-driven, service-oriented, and microservices architectures.

  • Experience building distributed, cloud-native systems using AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, and S3.

  • Experience working with NoSQL technologies such as DynamoDB or DocumentDB and relational SQL databases.

  • Strong experience designing REST and GraphQL APIs, including API security and versioning strategies.

  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming and messaging technologies.

  • Experience implementing logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and telemetry for production systems.

  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD practices, and supporting production applications.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience building document management, content services, or search-driven applications.

  • Deep expertise with event-driven architectures and Kafka.

  • Experience building high-performance React applications at scale.

  • Experience integrating AI-powered services into production applications.

  • Experience building B2B SaaS products in the legal industry or other regulated environments.

  • Mobile development or cross-platform application experience.

  • Contributions to open-source projects, technical writing, or experience sharing technical expertise with broader engineering communities.

What You’ll Love About NetDocuments

  • The People!

  • 90% healthcare premiums company covered

  • HSA company contribution

  • 401K match at 4% with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO, typically 3 to 4 weeks a year

  • 10 paid holidays

  • Monthly contributions for life activities and wellness

  • Access to LinkedIn Learning with monthly dedicated time to explore

  • Connection, access, and mentorship from exceptional leaders

  • Growing company with opportunities for advancement

  • Authenticity and accountability from leadership

Compensation Transparency

The compensation range for this position is $170,000–$190,000.

The posted cash compensation includes on-target earnings. Some roles may qualify for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.

Equal Opportunity

NetDocuments is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, (including pregnancy), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, military and veteran status, or any other status protected by laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. NetDocuments believes diversity and inclusion among our employees is critical to our success, and we are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

raw.description:
Founding Sales Development Representative (SDR) — AI & Zero Trust Security

Remote (US) · ET or CT time zone · [$60,000 base / $90,000 OTE] + equity

The short version: NetFoundry, the company behind OpenZiti, the world’s most used open source Zero Trust networking software, is hiring two founding SDRs to build NetFoundry's outbound engine. This is a hunter role selling Zero Trust connectivity into cybersecurity, cloud, and AI infrastructure teams. If you want to build the playbook instead of inheriting one and have ambition to become an AE, keep reading.

Why this matters now:

AI broke the network security model.

Agents, models, and APIs now need to reach data and systems scattered across clouds, data centers, edge sites, and customer environments. Every one of those connections is a new attack surface. VPNs, open inbound ports, and firewall rules were never designed for a world where the thing requesting access is a non-human identity that spun up four seconds ago.

NetFoundry replaces that model. Our Identity-First Connectivity™ platform delivers Zero Trust connectivity with no VPNs, no open inbound ports, and no firewall changes enabling enterprises to connect AI agents, APIs, and distributed workloads without exposing anything to the internet.

Enterprises use us to secure access to their APIs and agentic AI services, to run microsegmentation, and to simplify hybrid IT/OT segmentation. Software and IoT providers use us to reach workloads inside their customers' networks.

We were founded by the inventors and maintainers of OpenZiti, the world's most-used open source Zero Trust networking software. We're Series A, backed by SYN Ventures and Cisco Investments, headquartered in Charlotte, NC, and remote-first since day one.

The role:

We have one SDR today. We're hiring two more, and we're building the enterprise go-to-market motion around you.

That means the target account strategy, the sequences, the call openers, the objection handling, the way we mine our open source community for enterprise signal - isn't fully developed yet. You'll contribute to it working directly with our AEs, our marketing team, and GTM leadership that has built and exited multiple startups.

This is the right role if you want to be early. It's the wrong role if you want a machine that already runs.

A note on leads: This is an outbound focused role. Marketing supports you with content, campaigns, and intent data. Pieline starts with you, on the phone.

What you'll do:

  • Own outbound pipeline generation into a defined set of enterprise accounts — you build the list, you work the list
  • Cold call. Daily. This is the core of the job, not a footnote
  • Run multi-channel outbound across phone, email, and LinkedIn, with real personalization rather than merge fields
  • Run discovery that surfaces real pain: firewall and VPN sprawl, exposed APIs, OT segmentation projects, AI agents that need access to sensitive systems
  • Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and hit monthly and quarterly pipeline targets
  • Build account plans with AEs and multi-thread into security, networking, cloud, and platform teams
  • Act as our fastest feedback loop since you'll hear what the market says before anyone else. Leadership will change the messaging based on what you report.

What we're looking for:

  • Ambition to become an AE
  • 1–3 years in outbound SDR/BDR or inside sales, ideally in cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise technology
  • A track record you can put numbers to - activity, meetings booked, pipeline sourced, quota attainment
  • Genuine willingness to cold call, and the resilience to do it on the days it isn't working
  • Strong written communication; you can write an email a CISO would actually reply to
  • Comfort with technical buyers, and curiosity to learn what a firewall rule, a service mesh, and an AI agent actually are
  • Experience with CRM and sales engagement platforms (we run HubSpot)
  • Organized, coachable, and hard to discourage

Nice to have: Familiarity with Zero Trust or secure connectivity concepts; experience with open source or developer communities; account-based selling.

What you get:

  • A founding seat. You're among the first three SDRs at a company building a category, with direct access to GTM leadership and founders
  • A clear path to AE. Our SDR→AE path is 12-18 months for performers, and we'd rather promote you than hire around you
  • Competitive base with uncapped commission, plus meaningful equity — $60,000 base / $90,000 OTE (uncapped)
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision, plus expanded well-being benefits
  • Employer-paid life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability
  • 401k with company match
  • Unlimited PTO and paid holidays
  • Learning & development budget, technology stipend, internet stipend, SWAG stipend
  • Remote-first with flexible hours, as a globally distributed team
Salary: $60,000 base/ $90,000 OTE (uncapped) + equity
