Who Are Massive Rocket?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

We’re looking for an Operations & Logistics Specialist to own the operational workflows that keep our people and business running smoothly. You’ll work across People Operations, payroll, finance operations, travel, events, and internal systems, ensuring everything is accurate, timely, and well organised.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys ownership, improving processes, and making sure the details behind a growing company are handled properly.

What Will You Do?

  • Own end-to-end employee lifecycle operations, from contracts and onboarding through role changes, payroll updates, and offboarding.
  • Prepare and manage offer letters, employment contracts, addendums, and other people documentation, ensuring accuracy and timely execution.
  • Coordinate monthly payroll, contractor invoices, expenses, and approvals, ensuring payments are accurate and on time.
  • Manage company travel, accommodation, transport, itineraries, and employee travel queries.
  • Plan and coordinate company events, offsites, venues, vendors, and on-the-ground logistics.
  • Maintain accurate records across employee data, leave, sick days, bookings, expenses, contracts, and operational documentation.
  • Act as a key point of contact for HR and operational queries, resolving issues efficiently and escalating when required.
  • Manage SOWs, Change Orders, signatures, and documentation to ensure complete and accurate records.
  • Continuously improve operational workflows, documentation, and internal processes to make them more efficient and scalable.
  • Build and maintain automation and workflow improvements that reduce manual work, data entry, and errors.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 3+ years of experience in People Operations, HR Operations, Business Operations, Finance Operations, or a similar role.
  • Strong experience managing employee lifecycle processes, contracts, documentation, and HR administration.
  • Hands-on experience with payroll, contractor payments, expenses, and financial administration.
  • Excellent organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Experience coordinating travel, events, offsites, vendors, and company logistics.
  • Comfortable managing confidential employee and financial information with discretion.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with employees, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Process-oriented and proactive, with a track record of identifying ways to improve operational workflows.
  • Comfortable working with HRIS, payroll, expense, e-signature, and other business systems.
  • Experience using automation tools to reduce manual processes and improve data accuracy.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing, and internationally distributed environment.

Desirable

  • Experience in a startup, scale-up, agency, or remote-first company.
  • Experience managing operations across multiple countries or regions.
  • Familiarity with tools such as HRIS, payroll platforms, expense management, e-signature, and workflow automation tools.
  • Basic understanding of employment compliance and payroll requirements across multiple markets.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
• A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win
• A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond
• Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best
• Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter
• Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work
Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment
ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)
References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready
For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

Every enterprise moving from “we're piloting AI” to “AI is in production” runs into the same wall: governance, security, and connectivity for a traffic pattern nobody built for. That's the opportunity in front of this team, and it's why Professional Services is one of the fastest-growing parts of this company right now.

We're hiring a Professional Services Manager to lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers and Engagement Managers across Kong's US Professional Services organization. This is a leadership role, not a delivery role: you're directly responsible for delivery outcomes, staffing, and the growth of the people who sit hands-on with customer engineering teams every day.

You own the full engagement lifecycle for your book of business — staffing the right FDE and Engagement Manager on every account, holding the team to go-live dates and technical quality, and driving resolution personally on the highest-risk or highest-value accounts. You're operating at the intersection of people leadership, technical delivery, and enterprise account management, and you're judged on outcomes, not activity.

We want leaders who've done the implementation work themselves and now want to multiply that impact through a team: coach the engineers, coach the engagement managers, clear the blockers neither of them can clear alone, and build the delivery muscle that lets Kong keep pace with enterprise demand for API and AI connectivity.

You'll work daily with Solutions Architects, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Product Engineering — scoping engagements correctly before they land on your team, and feeding what you learn in the field straight back into how Kong builds and sells.

This is a rare seat: AI connectivity is a land grab right now, and the person who builds this team's delivery model in the next 18 months owns a track record that doesn't come around twice.

Impact

Lead the team that turns Kong's platform into production reality for some of the world's largest enterprises — the ones deciding right now how AI gets governed, secured, and scaled across their business.

Growth

Build your leadership craft against the fastest-moving category in enterprise software: AI connectivity, cloud-native architecture, and distributed systems at Fortune 500 scale. Prove out this team's model and the case for more scope writes itself.

Opportunity

Join a Professional Services organization growing as fast as the AI adoption curve it's built to serve — market-leading credibility behind every conversation you walk into, and a direct hand in building the delivery model while it's still being written.

What You'll Do

  • Manage and grow a team of Forward Deployed Engineers and Engagement Managers — hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

  • Own delivery outcomes across your book of business: go-live dates, technical quality, and customer satisfaction. Report on them with the same rigor you'd demand from your team.

  • Staff the right FDE and Engagement Manager to every engagement based on account complexity, technical scope, and team capacity.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions Architecture to scope new engagements accurately and take clean handoffs from pre-sale to delivery.

  • Set and enforce delivery standards across your team — reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and best practices that outlive any single engagement.

  • Feed what your team learns in the field back to Kong Product and Engineering — real customer signal shapes our roadmap.

  • Lead your team's work on the strategic initiatives that matter most right now: AI connectivity, governance, platform modernization, and cloud-native transformation.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • 8+ years in customer-facing engineering, professional services, or platform engineering, including 2+ years directly managing a technical, customer-facing team.

  • A track record of delivery leadership in API gateways, API management, integrations, or distributed systems platforms — deep enough that you can direct and evaluate your team's work, not just review it.

  • Experience managing staffing, capacity, and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent enterprise engagements.

  • Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure fluency — enough to unblock your team and hold your own with customer architects and executives.

  • Experience with major cloud providers: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Comfort directing and evaluating automation frameworks, deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or migration tooling built by your team.

  • Prior experience in API Management, Open Source, Middleware, SaaS, or Infrastructure software companies is a strong plus.

Preferred Attributes

  • A decisive leadership mindset — you make the staffing and prioritization call and drive it to resolution without needing to do the work yourself.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving enterprise environments where the right call today beats the perfect call next week.

  • A genuine passion for growing engineers and engagement managers into their next role — this job is measured in the careers you build, not just the accounts you save.

  • Excellent communication across technical and executive audiences, internal and customer-facing.

  • Highly organized, with strong prioritization and execution across a multi-account portfolio.

  • Real enthusiasm for AI, modern infrastructure, and cloud-native technology — this team is living the shift, not reading about it.

  • A strong sense of ownership for outcomes that aren't always fully in your control — that's the job.

Director, Health Equity

Director, Health Equity

Who are we? Versant Health is one of the nation's leading administrators of managed vision care, serving over 35 million of our clients' members across the United States. Our purpose is to make healthy vision a reality for everyone by improving access to care and education in the communities we serve. Fueled by our mission to improve members' lives with easy-to-use vision solutions rooted in choice value, and care, we believe that everyone has the power to become anything they set their sights on.

See how you can make a difference with the support of strong leadership and a team environment.

Versant Health: Making Healthy Vision a Reality for Everyone

What are we looking for? The Director, Health Equity, leads the development, execution, measurement, and continuous improvement of Versant Health’s enterprise Health Equity strategy and program. Reporting to the Chief Clinical Officer, the Director aligns Health Equity priorities and initiatives with the organization’s broader clinical strategy, business objectives, and governance. Health Equity refers to ensuring that every person has a fair and just opportunity to achieve optimal health, regardless of factors such as race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic status, geography, preferred language, or other barriers that may influence access to care or health outcomes. The role provides leadership and oversight for the enterprise Health Equity program and assigned Health Equity initiatives, guiding the organization’s approach to identifying and reducing disparities, advancing equitable care, and integrating Health Equity considerations into applicable programs, operations, and decision-making. The Director establishes program objectives and measures, monitors performance, and coordinates with clinical, operational, quality, compliance, analytical, client-facing, and community-facing partners to translate Health Equity priorities into sustainable practices and measurable outcomes. The position also provides subject-matter expertise and recommendations to senior and executive leadership, clients, and other stakeholders regarding Health Equity strategy, requirements, risks, opportunities, and program performance.

Where you will have an impact

  • Lead the development, implementation, measurement, and continuous improvement of Versant Health’s enterprise health equity strategy and program to achieve defined annual objectives, fulfill applicable client and regulatory commitments, improve equitable access to care and reduce identified disparities.
  • Research, identify, develop, and evaluate Health Equity models, providing recommendations to advance strategic objectives, reduce health disparities, and improve equitable access to care and health outcomes.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on Health Equity, social determinants of health, culturally and linguistically responsive practices, cultural diversity and inclusion, and accreditation requirements for Versant Health and its stakeholders.
  • Establish and provide accountability for program objectives, implementation plans, performance measures, and reporting processes; monitor results, identify risks and performance gaps, and recommend corrective actions or improvements requiring approval by the accountable business owner.
  • Coordinate with clinical, operational, quality, compliance, analytical, client-facing, and community-facing partners to implement approved health equity priorities across applicable programs, policies, procedures, and business practices.
  • Advise accountable business owners on potential inequities identified through reviews of policies, procedures, programs, and practices; recommend policy revisions and corrective actions, while final approval remains with the designated policy owner or governance body.
  • Develop and coordinate ongoing Trauma-Informed Care education and training for applicable providers, subcontractors, associates, and other individuals with direct member contact.
  • Lead the evaluation, preparation, and ongoing readiness activities necessary to attain a nationally recognized accreditation within contractually required timeframes, including coordination of program documentation, evidence, measurement, corrective actions, and cross-functional deliverables.
  • Foster community engagement by establishing a Community Advisory Council(s) to gather member and community perspectives, support applicable program requirements, and inform health equity priorities and improvements.
  • Oversee required health equity reporting and analyses for applicable clients and stakeholders, including but not limited to reporting related to Community Advisory Council demographic representation, governance, and operating policies and procedures:
  • Annual Community Advisory Council Demographic Report: Demonstrates how council membership represents the communities within the applicable service area and satisfies associated annual reporting requirements.
  • Annual Community Advisory Council Policies and Procedures Report: Documents the policies and procedures governing operation of the council and satisfies associated annual reporting requirements.
  • Support applicable proposals, client implementations, due diligence, audits, regulatory inquiries, and client education involving Health Equity requirements, capabilities, commitments, and program performance.
  • Develop and present Health Equity program performance, risks, opportunities, policy priorities, corrective actions, resource needs, and recommendations to the Chief Clinical Officer, senior and executive leadership, clients, and appropriate governance bodies.
  • Manage assigned staff, consultants, vendors, budgets, and other program resources and promote effective performance, collaboration, and professional development.
  • Travel as required to fulfill job responsibilities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What’s necessary to do the job?

Experience, Education, and Certifications/Licenses: Education Bachelor's Degree

Required

Notes: Bachelor’s degree in public health, community health, health sciences, nursing, healthcare administration, or a related healthcare or social science field required. Master’s degree in a related field preferred.

Experience 8 Years

Required

Notes:

8+ years of progressive experience in Health Equity, public health, population health, clinical care or clinical operations, healthcare quality, managed care, health plan operations, community health, or a related healthcare discipline required. 5+ years of leadership experience overseeing teams, enterprise programs, or complex cross-functional initiatives required. Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, and measuring Health Equity, population health, public health, or quality-improvement programs required. Experience translating regulatory, accreditation, contractual, or client requirements into sustainable programs, controls, and measurable outcomes required. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior leaders, business partners, clients, and external stakeholders required. Experience using data to identify disparities, evaluate program performance, establish priorities, and recommend interventions required. Experience supporting Medicaid, Medicare, Commercial, or other government-sponsored healthcare programs preferred. Experience with Health Equity accreditation, healthcare quality measures, culturally and linguistically responsive programs, community partnerships, or barriers-to-care initiatives preferred. Clinical experience or demonstrated experience partnering with clinical leaders and care delivery professionals to advance Health Equity, quality, population health, or member outcome initiatives preferred.

Licenses and Certifications Relevant Certification

Preferred

Notes: Relevant clinical licensure, Certified in Public Health (CPH), Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ), project or program management certification, or another relevant public health, healthcare quality, or Health Equity credential preferred.

HIPAA & Security Requirements All Associates must comply with the Health Insurance Portability Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) as it pertains to disclosures of protected health information (PHI) as described in the Notice of Privacy Practices and HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures. As a component of job roles and responsibilities, Associates may have access to covered information, cardholder data or other confidential customer information which must be protected at all times. As a result, Associates must explicitly adhere to all data security guidelines established within the Company’s Privacy & Security Training Program.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package designed to support your health, financial well being, and work life balance. Benefits include medical, dental, and paid vision coverage; paid time off and company holidays; retirement savings with employer contribution; employee wellness resources; and professional development opportunities. Additional benefits may include flexible work arrangements, employee assistance programs, and other programs that support you both at work and beyond.

Location preferred: APAC, Brazil, or US

About ELSA

ELSA is a leading innovator in English communication assessment technology, dedicated to transforming how people improve their English skills. Our flagship product, ELSA Speak, acts as a personal mobile coach, helping users enhance their communication abilities by providing real-time feedback on what they say (grammar and vocabulary) and how they say it (pronunciation and intonation). By leveraging advanced signal processing and generative AI, ELSA Speak identifies user errors and delivers precise, consistent and actionable guidance for improvement.

At ELSA, our vision is to be the global leader in teaching real-time, conversational English, with the aim of helping over 1.5 billion language learners worldwide. We are here to celebrate and empower every individual on the global stage to build confidence, be understood, and help share their story. Come join our very talented team of people working to make a difference using the power of AI, with our proprietary speech recognition technology!

About the Role

We are seeking a UI/UX Designer to join the Learn Team within ELSAs AI Department a cross-functional team shaping the future of learning experiences across ELSA product ecosystem.

Youll design intuitive, motivating, and data-informed learning interfaces, working closely with Learning Experience Designers, AI engineers, and Product Managers. The ideal candidate combines strong UX design skills with an understanding of learning design and pedagogy, creating user journeys that are not only beautiful but also educationally effective.

Key Responsibilities

1. Learning-Focused UX & Product Design

  • Design and prototype learner journeys and interfaces that make complex language learning goals feel simple, rewarding, and intuitive.
  • Apply learning experience principles to enhance engagement, flow, and comprehension.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and data analysis to inform design decisions and improve learning outcomes.

2. Collaboration Across AI, Product, and Learning

  • Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to translate pedagogical goals into user-centered product features.
  • Partner with AI and Product teams to design experiences that integrate real-time feedback, personalization, and adaptive learning.
  • Create design systems and guidelines to ensure consistent, high-quality learner experiences across platforms.

3. Data-Driven Design & Iteration

  • Use quantitative and qualitative data (engagement metrics, completion rates, UX tests) to measure and improve design effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with the analytics and AI teams to visualize learner progress and feedback in meaningful ways.
  • Iterate rapidly using tools like Figma, Figjam, Looker or Amplitude to validate design hypotheses.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelors degree in UI/UX Design, HCI, Interaction Design, Educational Technology, or a related field.
  • 46 years of experience in UI/UX, product design, or learning design, ideally in EdTech, SaaS, or mobile-first environments.
  • Proven ability to prototype, test, and iterate learning-focused interfaces in tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Experience designing data-informed and user-centered workflows.
  • Familiarity with learning psychology, instructional design principles, or digital education environments.
  • Excellent visual design, communication, and storytelling skills.

Preferred

  • Experience designing AI-powered or adaptive learning systems.
  • Familiarity with language learning products or communication training.
  • Understanding of localization and accessibility in global markets.
  • Basic skills in motion design or micro-interaction prototyping.

Why Join ELSA

  • Shape the future of AI-driven English learning, reaching billions of users globally.
  • Collaborate with a world-class team at the intersection of AI, product, and pedagogy.
  • Contribute to a mission that helps people build confidence and communicate freely.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Flexible remote-first environment with opportunities for impact and growth.

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

Location note

We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India.

The Opportunity

This newly created role supports Oportun's 24/7 Cyber Security Operations Center by conducting technical analysis of security events and supporting immediate containment, investigation, and remediation. The Security Analyst also helps strengthen defenses by applying knowledge gained throughout the response process.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • Monitor and analyze traffic, security events, and alerts, and advise on appropriate remediation actions.
  • Review and assess the impact of security incidents and the remediation actions required to address them.
  • Investigate intrusion attempts and analyze exploits by correlating multiple sources to determine affected systems or data sets.
  • Follow standard operating procedures for detecting, classifying, documenting, and reporting security incidents.
  • Analyze network and host-based security appliance logs, including EDR, firewalls, NIDS, HIDS, and system logs, to determine remediation actions and escalation paths.
  • Independently identify, contain, analyze, document, and eradicate malicious activity in accordance with established procedures.
  • Escalate intrusion events, security incidents, threat indicators, and warning information to the appropriate client and stakeholders.
  • Look for practical ways to use AI tools thoughtfully to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You're comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing competing demands, and meeting deadlines. You communicate effectively across functional boundaries, build strong partnerships with engineering and security teams, and bring genuine interest in security, technology, and automation.

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

  • You have a bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field from an accredited institution, or 2–5 years of relevant experience in SOC, incident response, or cyber forensics.
  • You have at least 2 years of prior SOC experience, including relevant internships.
  • You have experience working with Splunk SIEM and analyzing logs from security devices such as firewalls, proxies, and EDR platforms.
  • You have hands-on experience handling cyber incidents, performing L1 ticket analysis, identifying false positives, and correlating incidents.
  • You understand network architecture and can connect events logically across systems and environments.
  • You have working knowledge of the TCP/IP suite and OSI protocol layers, network and systems architecture, and intrusion detection systems.
  • You understand web application architecture, Active Directory, and major application-layer protocols such as HTTP, SMTP, and DNS.
  • You understand common malware categories and how they function, including rootkits, trojans, adware, exploits, and fileless malware.
  • You have strong organizational, time-management, prioritization, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across functional and organizational boundaries.

Nice to Have

  • You have experience working with or partnering closely with network, engineering, and application teams.
  • You hold a preferred security certification such as Security+ or a similar credential.
  • You've used AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to improve your own productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to beopen to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

India Benefits:

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance;

Provident Fund; Life & Accident Insurance;

Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances.

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: .

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

Olsson provides multidisciplinary, preliminary, and construction design services for mixed-use, commercial, and residential land development projects, along with industrial, sports, schools, and other site development types.

The Client Manager role serves as the main point of contact for a specific client, a division of a larger client, or a targeted client at the team level, establishing solid relationships, building and maintaining a strong rapport, and ensuring overall client satisfaction. The Client Manager oversees client service management for the team, ensuring services that provide purposeful, high-quality solutions to successfully solve engineering and design needs.

raw.description:
Data Scientist - Partner Flow - UK

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Partner Flow team.

You'll use experiments and causal inference to shape how iwoca grows through its partners – the fintechs and platforms that offer iwoca lending inside their own products.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Partner Flow owns the journey for small businesses that come to iwoca through a partner platform, from how they discover iwoca’s business finance to any repeat lending. The aim is to reach each business at the right time, make it easy to apply and get funded, and match them with the offer that suits them and works best for iwoca over time.

The team works on three parts of that journey:

  • The application. Making it smooth and collecting the data a credit decision needs.

  • Routing. Working out which applications get an automatic decision and which need input from a credit analyst.

  • Offer terms. Testing amount, duration, and interest rate, working closely with Credit Risk Modelling, who build the credit models.

The team is small and cross-functional – data science, engineering, design, and product – and works across the full application stack, from the APIs partners integrate with to the experience customers see when they apply.

The role

As the Data Scientist in Partner Flow, you'll run the analysis behind the team's product decisions. Most of it is experiment design and causal inference, with some model building and funnel analysis.

You'll own each project from the start. You'll work out what the business needs, reason from first principles, weigh the trade-offs, and shape the project with product, commercial, and strategy colleagues before deciding how it gets done. The team's analytical approach is still young, so you'll help set its methods. Around 10% of your time is for research and learning – finding better methods for the problems in front of you, or new ways to add value.

You'll work with data scientists in iwoca's other customer flow teams, and join the analytics guild – iwoca's data science community – to align on methods and build your expertise. Your results reach the wider business through Learnings – short write-ups of what an experiment found, shared at weekly and fortnightly sessions.

Live project examples:

  • Pre-qualification. Measuring how showing customers what they could borrow before they apply affects conversion and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV), then shaping how the model behind it develops.

  • Credit cards. Working out which customers should see iwoca's recently launched credit card, a Flexi-Loan, or both – and whether the card wins extra customers or takes them from Flexi-Loan.

  • Top-up notifications. Measuring whether letting eligible customers know they can borrow more increases CLtV, using causal inference methods beyond a standard A/B test.

  • Partner funnel. Building a clear view from application to drawdown, finding where customers drop off, and testing fixes where they'll matter most.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Causal inference and experimentation. You have designed and analysed experiments where separating signal from noise mattered – A/B tests, quasi-experiments, or lift studies. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead.

  • Commercial experience. You have used data science to shape commercial decisions – in an industry role, a consultancy, or a substantial placement – and worked alongside the people who acted on them.

  • Analytical ownership. You have taken loosely defined problems from start to finish – working out the right question, choosing the approach, and seeing the analysis through to a decision.

  • Iteration. You make the best call the current evidence allows and act on it early. As new data comes in, you update the call and tighten the answer.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered alone – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles.

Bonus:

  • Causal inference beyond A/B testing. You have used synthetic control, interrupted time series, or difference-in-differences in commercial or research work.

  • Bayesian methods. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Funnel and marketplace experience. You have analysed conversion funnels or marketplaces where products compete for customers' attention.

  • Market curiosity. You've explored how the partner lending market works – what makes a partner choose iwoca over a competitor, and what makes a customer convert.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation Range: £70K - £100K

raw.description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Admin Assistant

Compensation range: $1,300 AUD - $1,800 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an established Australian financial services business supporting businesses and investors with flexible funding solutions.

The company works closely with clients and professional partners to provide practical financing options, with a strong focus on responsiveness, clear communication, and efficient deal management.

The team is currently small and collaborative, with around eight people, and the business is entering an exciting stage of expansion. As operations continue to grow, they are strengthening the team and putting the right people and processes in place to support the next phase of the business.

This role will be an important addition to the team, providing the opportunity to contribute directly to the business as it continues to scale.

Role Overview: We're looking for a reliable, highly organised assistant to support our lending and operations team.

You'll keep loan applications and day-to-day administration on track so our Australian team can focus on clients, brokers and lending decisions.

You don't need to be a finance expert from day one. Attention to detail, initiative, energy and the ability to learn quickly matter most.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Loan administration: Enter and update applicant and loan details, check that required documents have been received and correctly filed, maintain application status records, and prepare files for assessment and settlement.
  • Follow-ups: Chase outstanding documents and information from brokers, clients and team members, professionally and promptly.
  • Broker and client support: Handle admin enquiries and make sure information passes accurately between brokers, clients and the team.
  • General administration: Manage emails, update the CRM and internal trackers, maintain digital files, prepare spreadsheets and reports, and help schedule meetings.
  • Process improvement: Spot bottlenecks, suggest better ways of working, and support the team during busy periods when fast turnaround is needed.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience as a Virtual Assistant, Admin Assistant, Loan Processor, Finance Assistant or similar.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Confidence with Microsoft Office / Google Workspace, and strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Comfort learning new software and systems.
  • A reliable, proactive approach and the ability to work independently.
  • The discretion to handle confidential financial information appropriately.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in Australian lending, mortgage broking or finance administration.
  • Experience with loan applications, financial documents and CRM / loan-management software.
  • Experience supporting an Australian business and familiarity with Australian business terminology.

What Success Looks Like

You'll become a reliable extension of the team, so that applications are organised and progressing, documentation is complete and easy to find, outstanding items are followed up quickly, records are accurate, and our lending team spends less time on admin and more time on deals and relationships.

Growth & Opportunity

As the business grows, so will this role. We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us, not just fill a seat. For the right person, there is a clear path to take on more responsibility over time, such as loan processing, settlement coordination and deeper involvement in the lending process.

You'll work directly with our Australian team, learn how a private lender operates from the inside, and have the chance to shape how we work as we scale. Strong performance will be recognised, with reviews as your skills and responsibilities increase.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

raw.description:
Who We Are: Front Office Transformation Experts

Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.

What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office

We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.

The Role

As a Marketo Consultant (Contractor), you will serve as the lead practitioner on high-value client engagements across the EMEA or North American regions. This is a hands-on, execution-focused, and client-facing remote role where you will own the client relationship, map out roadmaps, and manage platform delivery from end to end. You will work closely with our internal project managers and engineering teams during standard business hours to deliver top-tier Marketo implementations, optimize marketing automation setups, and build robust integrations—particularly with Microsoft Dynamics CRM. Your objective will be to untangle operational complexity and ensure our enterprise clients achieve rapid, scalable time-to-value without needing hand-holding.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Implementation: Lead and support the full deployment of Adobe Marketo Engage for enterprise customers, customizing environments to meet specific business requirements.
  • CRM Integration: Design, implement, and troubleshoot robust data flows and integrations between Marketo and Microsoft Dynamics CRM.
  • Managed Services Support: Oversee ongoing operations including campaign execution, program optimization, lead lifecycle management, platform administration, and data quality assurance.
  • Client Advisory: Directly manage client relationships, lead weekly syncs, facilitate stakeholder workshops, and translate technical configurations into clear strategic roadmaps.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Bluprintx Solution Architects and Project Managers to keep delivery timelines strictly on track.
  • Technical Documentation: Produce clear, comprehensive documentation covering implementation processes, technical configurations, and workflow architectures.

Requirements

  • Certification: Active Adobe Certified Professional/Expert in Marketo Engage (Mandatory).
  • Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience driving enterprise Marketo implementations and delivering ongoing managed services.
  • Integration Expertise: Proven track record of configuring and troubleshooting Marketo integrations with Microsoft Dynamics CRM.
  • Client Management: Demonstrable experience leading client relationships, managing stakeholders, and acting as an autonomous consultant.
  • Availability: Ability to operate reliably during standard regional business hours (EMEA or North America).
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with a sharp eye for detail (e.g., catching misaligned UTMs before deployment).

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).
  • Prior experience working within a fast-paced agency or MarTech consultancy model.
  • Understanding of APIs, web services, and middleware integration tools.

Why this opportunity is unique

This role offers direct client ownership from day one alongside a highly flexible contractor arrangement, allowing experienced freelancers to rapidly scale their network and work on diverse, enterprise-level integration projects.

Anticipated Salary Range:

The anticipated pay range for this role is $90 to $130 per hour.

raw.title: Senior Manager, US Indirect Tax Controversy
raw.excerpt: About the TeamThe Tax Controversy team serves DoorDash by producing excellent controversy outcomes, providing timely and accurate information on material risks to the business, and improving the tax team with actionable feedback from audits.
raw.description:
About the Team

The Tax Controversy team serves DoorDash by producing excellent controversy outcomes, providing timely and accurate information on material risks to the business, and improving the tax team with actionable feedback from audits. As DoorDash's business has grown across the United States and the world, so have its tax audits and appeals.

You will report to the leader of the US Indirect Tax Controversy function and work alongside a Manager who manages audits and an Associate Manager who owns the team's data and analytics. You will engage with partners across Tax Compliance, Accounting, Tax Tech, and Planning. You will be able to work remotely, based within the US, with limited travel for team events, offsites, and select audit meetings.

About the Role

This role is responsible for the execution of DoorDash's portfolio of US indirect tax audits — sales and use tax, gross receipts taxes, property taxes, and business license taxes. You will own how that work gets done: the audit management process, the reporting that tells the tax department where we stand, and the cross-functional channels that supply the facts, data, and documents our audits depend on.

This role requires judgement. Our audits can turn on unsettled questions. You will direct the methods, the positions, and the evaluation criteria for defending these matters, on facts that are frequently incomplete and in jurisdictions that frequently disagree. You will act independently on new and unusual matters, direct the work of others on the team without carrying people-management responsibility, and carry a select portfolio of audits yourself.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own execution across the full US indirect tax audit portfolio. Direct how each sales and use tax, gross receipts tax, property tax, and business license audit is staffed — and personally manage a select set of audits so you stay close to the work.
  • Make the portfolio legible. Design and sustain the trackers, cadences, and metrics that turn dozens of concurrent audits into a clear picture of exposure by issue, aging, status, and outcomes — putting AI and analytics tooling to work alongside the team’s analytics Associate Manager and the Tax Tech team.
  • Build the network that audits run on. Build strong, cross-functional channels across Tax Compliance, Tax Tech, Accounting, Planning, and Operations to quickly secure the data and facts essential to audit defense.
  • Resolve controversies. Set defense strategy, negotiate with state and local auditors, and bring matters to resolution — escalating with a clear recommendation when the exposure or the issue warrants it.
  • Surface the issues that change decisions elsewhere. Identify high-impact audit issues early — those affecting current planning, carrying significant value, or drawing senior visibility — and get them to your manager with the analysis needed to act.
  • Be a senior voice on the team. Mentor a Manager and an Associate Manager, review their work, set the standard for audit craft, and build your own command of DoorDash's tax positions across tax types and jurisdictions.

We're excited about you because…

  • You have 8+ years of professional experience in state and local tax audits, controversy, or compliance, gained in a Big 4 or consulting firm indirect tax practice, a state or local revenue agency, or an in-house corporate tax function with a meaningful indirect tax operation.
  • You have managed audits end to end with state and local auditors, including information document requests, sampling methodologies, workpaper negotiation, and settlement discussions.
  • You are a process owner by instinct. You have built the tracker, the cadence, or the reporting package that a function then ran on, and you can describe what it changed.
  • You defend unsettled positions. You can describe a matter where the law was unclear, the facts were incomplete, and you decided how to proceed — and explain how you got comfortable.
  • You thoroughly understand sales and use taxes, including marketplace facilitator laws. Experience with US gross receipts taxes (e.g., Washington B&O, San Francisco GRT), property taxes, or business license taxes is a strong plus.
  • You are resourceful and persistent in getting what an audit needs. You go find the business owner, the system of record, and the answer.
  • You are an enthusiastic user of modern AI tools (e.g., Claude) in a professional context.
  • You have a strong moral compass and compassion for others.
  • You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree. A CPA, CMI, MST, or equivalent credential is a plus.

We expect this position to be filled by 05/12/2026

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$155,000—$228,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only

We used Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provided Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023. We resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024, and ceased using Covey Scout for Inbound on April 30, 2026.

The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Job Summary

The Head of Innovation leads the organization's innovation strategy, emerging-technology agenda, experimentation, and development of new products, services, business models, and operating approaches.

Within Insurance & Investments, the role identifies opportunities to use AI, automation, InsurTech, FinTech, data, digital platforms, and emerging technologies to improve customer experience, underwriting, claims, investment management, distribution, operational efficiency, and revenue growth.

The role acts as a bridge between business strategy, technology, digital transformation, product development, and external innovation ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

Innovation Strategy

Develop and execute the enterprise innovation strategy and roadmap.

Establish innovation priorities aligned with corporate and business-unit objectives.

Identify emerging market, technology, customer, and business-model trends.

Build an innovation pipeline covering short-, medium-, and long-term opportunities.

Establish innovation governance, frameworks, KPIs, and investment criteria.

Develop business cases and ROI models for innovation initiatives.

Product & Business Model Innovation

Identify opportunities for new insurance and investment products.

Develop and test new digital products, services, and customer propositions.

Explore alternative distribution and revenue models.

Lead proof-of-concepts, pilots, MVPs, and commercialization programs.

Conduct market and competitor analysis.

Use customer insights to identify unmet needs and new opportunities.

Insurance Innovation

Focus areas may include:

AI-enabled underwriting

Automated claims processing

Digital claims journeys

Predictive risk assessment

Telematics and usage-based insurance

Embedded insurance

Digital distribution

InsurTech partnerships

Fraud detection

Automated customer service

Personalized insurance products

IoT-enabled risk monitoring

Investment & Wealth Innovation

Explore AI/analytics-enabled investment solutions.

Identify opportunities in digital wealth management.

Develop new investor engagement and self-service models.

Explore robo-advisory and personalized investment experiences.

Improve portfolio analytics and investor reporting.

Evaluate emerging investment technologies and fintech platforms.

Identify opportunities for alternative investment products and distribution models.

Emerging Technology

Evaluate and develop use cases involving:

Artificial Intelligence

Generative AI

Machine Learning

Automation / RPA

Blockchain / Distributed Ledger Technology

Cloud Computing

APIs

IoT

Advanced Analytics

Low-code / No-code

Digital Identity

Open Banking / Open Finance

FinTech / InsurTech platforms

Innovation Labs & Experimentation

Establish innovation labs, accelerators, or internal innovation programs.

Lead ideation workshops and design-thinking initiatives.

Develop prototypes and MVPs.

Test new technologies in controlled environments.

Establish criteria for scaling successful pilots.

Stop or redesign initiatives that do not demonstrate sufficient business value.

External Ecosystem & Partnerships

Build relationships with FinTechs, InsurTechs, startups, universities, technology providers, venture ecosystems, and research organizations.

Identify strategic partnerships and investment opportunities.

Evaluate startup technologies and potential strategic fit.

Manage innovation challenges, hackathons, accelerators, and partnerships.

Represent the organization at innovation and industry forums.

Data, AI & Digital Transformation

Partner with Data & Analytics teams on AI and advanced analytics opportunities.

Work with Digital and Technology leadership to scale successful innovations.

Identify automation opportunities across operations.

Promote data-driven experimentation and decision-making.

Ensure innovation initiatives complement the broader digital and technology roadmap.

Governance, Risk & Regulation

Ensure innovation initiatives comply with financial-services regulations.

Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Information Security, and Data Privacy teams.

Establish responsible AI and technology governance.

Assess cybersecurity, privacy, operational, financial, and regulatory risks.

Establish appropriate controls for experimentation and production deployment.

Leadership & Commercialization

Build and lead innovation teams and cross-functional squads.

Manage innovation budgets and investment portfolios.

Establish innovation KPIs and executive reporting.

Track revenue, cost savings, customer impact, adoption, and ROI.

Develop commercialization plans for successful innovations.

Present innovation opportunities and results to executive leadership and the Board.

Ideal Candidate Profile

12–18+ years of experience across innovation, strategy, digital transformation, product, technology, consulting, or financial services.

5+ years in senior leadership roles.

Proven experience building and executing innovation strategies.

Strong understanding of emerging technologies and their commercial applications.

Experience with FinTech, InsurTech, AI, automation, digital products, analytics, or platform businesses.

Strong product-development and business-model innovation experience.

Experience taking concepts from ideation PoC MVP pilot commercialization.

Strong understanding of financial-services business models.

Experience working with startups, technology vendors, accelerators, or innovation ecosystems.

Excellent strategic thinking, commercial judgment, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, or related field; MBA/master's preferred.

When joining PerkinElmer, you select an experienced and trusted leader in scientific solutions, with the support of a global service network and distribution centers, providing the right solution, at the right time, to meet critical customer needs. With over an 80+ year legacy of advancing science and a mission of innovating for a healthier world, our dedicated team collaborates closely with commercial, government, academic and healthcare customers to deliver our broad portfolio of analytical solutions, and OneSource services.

Job Title

Quality Assurance Director


Location(s)

US Remote - AZ, US Remote - CA, US Remote - CO, US Remote - IL, US Remote - KS, US Remote - MN, US Remote - OR, US Remote - TX, US Remote - WA

Job Description

This is a full-time salaried position withProject Farma, a PerkinElmer company. The successful candidate will reside in one of Project Farma's primary markets and be willing to travel domestically to meet client project requests.


Project Farma’s purpose is to improve patient lives by accelerating the delivery of life-changing therapies. We accomplish this through the successful execution of high-quality life sciences projects across the full project lifecycle. Project Farma (PF) team members collaborate with cross-functional teams to build trusted client relationships, deliver an exceptional customer experience, and contribute to business growth by identifying opportunities and applying data-driven insights to support project planning, cost, schedule, and performance management.


This role contributes to organizational success by supporting financial performance, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement, while also investing in people through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and professional development.


All team members are expected to embody Project Farma’s values by being curious, personable, and unselfish, while maintaining a strong commitment to a Patient Focused and People First mindset.


The Director QA/RA is a deeply experienced individual responsible for supporting project execution through technical contribution, analysis, and problem-solving with limited guidance. May serve as project QA/RA lead or project lead / manager. This role applies intermediate to advanced technical expertise on more than one subject to solve complex problems, contributes meaningfully to project outcomes, and demonstrates increased independence in executing assigned work. Directors are expected to build foundational skills, apply Project Farma methodologies, and deliver high-quality work products while collaborating across disciplines. This role requires sound judgment, effective prioritization, within established project frameworks, and continued growth toward greater ownership and technical proficiency. The Director is responsible for leading a team and overseeing the execution of work aligned to project, client, and business objectives. raw.excerpt: About PushPressPushPress is the AI-powered gym management platform built for boutique fitness.
raw.description:
About PushPress
PushPress is the AI-powered gym management platform built for boutique fitness.

We are transforming how boutique fitness owners operate and how the entire $100B global fitness industry connects, transacts, and grows. Trusted by more than 5,000 gyms and 500,000 members, PushPress processes ~$1B annually.

We're a Series B company backed by Altos Ventures, StepStone, and Mucker Capital, and we're going all-in on AI. Our AI Assistant, AI Member Intel, and AI-powered reporting tools are already changing how gym owners and coaches operate. We believe AI should make the human side of fitness better, not replace it.

By embedding intelligence directly into the product, we enable boutique fitness owners to make faster decisions, unlock new revenue streams, and collaborate across a connected network. As more gyms join the platform, data compounds, intelligence strengthens, and the value of the ecosystem increases for every owner

We are a global team of builders, operators, and fitness fanatics on a mission to level the playing field for independent fitness entrepreneurs. If you are ready to help reshape an industry, let's talk!

The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Controller to own the financial backbone of PushPress.

We’re a Series B SaaS company navigating increasing financial complexity: traditional SaaS subscriptions, AI-driven usage-based revenue, a multi-layered payments business processing nearly $1B annually, and expansion into new geographies. Our revenue model spans subscription billing, platform payment economics, and emerging AI monetization, each with distinct recognition and compliance considerations.

As our first Controller, you’ll build on the foundational work the team has already laid out. You’ll have direct insight into company strategy to ensure you have the full context that goes into setting up our accounting infrastructure for the next phase of growth. While you’ll set the direction and own the process, you’ll also be in the details: closing the books, working through nuanced recognition questions, managing the order-to-cash flow, advising on product economics from a financial lens, owning cash flow forecasting, and rolling up your sleeves to get the job done.

What You'll Own

    Financial Close & Reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process end-to-end with speed, accuracy, and clear documentation
  • Prepare and review financial statements, reconciliations, and supporting schedules
  • Build and maintain internal controls that scale with the business and hold up under audit scrutiny
  • Establish the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership and the board clear, reliable visibility into company financials
  • Own vendor COGS tracking and margin analysis across product lines, ensuring cost structures are well-understood as the business scales

    • Revenue Recognition

  • Lead the application of ASC 606 across subscription SaaS, AI usage-based revenue, and platform payment revenue streams
  • Ensure the accounting treatment for payments economics is clean and defensible
  • Partner with GTM, Product, and Engineering to ensure billing architecture and revenue data support clean recognition
  • Own the full order-to-cash flow end-to-end, including how subscriptions and payments are created in Stripe, how invoices map to revenue, how settlements land, how refunds and disputes flow back, and how it all reconciles to the GL
  • Stay ahead of how our revenue model evolves (new AI features, new pricing structures, new markets) and flag accounting implications early

    • Cash Flow & Debt Facility

  • Own cash flow forecasting and management, giving leadership real, actionable visibility into liquidity
  • Manage compliance with our debt facility, including covenant tracking, lender reporting, and maintaining a healthy lender relationship
  • Partner with the leadership team on capital deployment decisions and ensure strategic use of the debt facility

    Tax & Compliance

  • Own multi-state income tax compliance and stay current across all jurisdictions
  • Lead SaaS taxability analysis and indirect tax obligations (sales/use tax) across states with nexus exposure, ensuring the company is correctly collecting and remitting where required
  • Build the accounting and systems foundation to support international expansion, including GST, HST, VAT, and other indirect tax regimes as we enter new markets
  • Own FX exposure tracking and multi-currency considerations as international revenue grows
  • Stay ahead of new tax and compliance obligations as the business scales and new products launch
    Operations & Infrastructure
  • Coordinate payroll, equity/options processing, billing, AR, AP, and cash management operations, ensuring accuracy and compliance
  • Evaluate and improve the accounting tech stack to support the complexity and scale ahead
  • Partner with data and engineering to ensure financial data flows are reliable, reconciled, and audit-ready; comfort working with or directing modern data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, Stripe) is a plus
  • Drive automation where it creates real leverage and accuracy; identify where manual processes are creating risk

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful ownership of the close, revenue recognition, and financial reporting
  • CPA required
  • Deep, working knowledge of ASC 606 applied to SaaS including subscription billing, usage-based models, and multi-element arrangements
  • Strong understanding of the full order-to-cash lifecycle in a Stripe-based billing environment
  • Experience managing or coordinating a debt facility, including covenant compliance and lender reporting
  • Multi-state tax compliance experience, including SaaS taxability and indirect tax; comfortable building out international tax capabilities as the business grows
  • Comfortable utilizing AI to automate workflows and create leverage and can speak to tangible process improvements
  • Have navigated ERP transitions (QBO, Rillet, Campfire, NetSuite, or similar)
  • High attention to detail paired with the ability to communicate clearly to non-finance stakeholders
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the norm

Nice to Have

  • Big 4 or public accounting background
  • Experience at a B2B SaaS startup, ideally with SMB customers
  • Exposure to payments, fintech, platform economics, or consumption/usage-based billing models
  • Experience with multi-currency reporting, FX management, or international entity structures
  • Prior experience building an accounting function from scratch or significantly restructuring one
  • Familiarity with AI-driven revenue models and the recognition complexity they introduce
  • Comfort with modern data stacks (Snowflake, dbt, Metabase) and financial data pipeline concepts
  • Experience with Ramp, Bill.com, or similar modern finance infrastructure

Benefits & Perks

  • Equity Incentive Plan
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (and Public Holidays)
  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (Company Sponsored 401k with Match)
  • Life Insurance
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Work From Home Stipend
  • Wellness Stipend
PushPress is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and dynamic workplace. We’re all about leveling up, and that means we don’t tolerate any form of discrimination or harassment. We’re committed to provide equal opportunities, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability, genetic info, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.
At PushPress, we’re dedicated to helping both our technology and our team reach peak performance. Whether it’s with your proactive approach, eye for detail, or drive to make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. At PushPress, we’re all about pushing boundaries and achieving new personal bests—come join us and be part of our fitness-tech journey!

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.
